name: MiniQuest Camps
description_short: Preschool camp for ages 3 to 4 at the YMCA's F.M. Kirby Children's Center in Madison, with a half day option (8 to 12:30) and a full day option (8 to 5) that adds swim lessons. Children must be toilet trained.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. MiniQuest 2026: ages 3 to 4 at F.M. Kirby Children's Center, Sessions 1 to 5 (weeks 1 to 10), half day 8 to 12:30 or full day 8 to 5, extended care 5 to 6 at extra cost. No camp Friday July 3. Address and phone for the Kirby Center from the page footer.

Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 payment schedule: Session 1 June 22 to July 2, Session 2 July 6 to 17, Session 3 July 20 to 31, Session 4 August 3 to 14, Session 5 August 17 to 27; drop in weeks also offered. $100 nonrefundable enrollment fee at registration. Financial assistance may be available through the Y. Weekly or session prices are not posted on the site or the public ActiveNet search.

unknowns: Weekly or session price (member and non-member)

for_andrew: One of three Madison Area YMCA Quest Camps drafts (with KidsQuest and SpecialtyQuest); each meets at its own place with its own ages. No prices are posted.
